main.description: Lists entities followed by an actor DID. No authentication is required; duplicate actor–entity relationships use the earliest createdAt, with URI ascending on ties. Only returned-page targets are hydrated and resolved to the latest indexed record by URI; missing or unsupported targets retain their URI and follow with entity null, while lookup failures return errors rather than partial pages.

actor.description: DID whose outgoing entity follows are listed.

sortDirection.description: Sorts by representative follow createdAt and URI; defaults to desc.

limit.description: Maximum relationships per page; defaults to 25.

cursor.description: Opaque next-page cursor bound to sortDirection; keep the other query parameters unchanged between pages.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: The actor DID or another query parameter is invalid.

cursor.description: Next-page cursor; omitted when no more results are available.
